# Sunny Land

Creator: Luis Zuno (Ansimuz)

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/sunny-land-2d-pixel-art-pack

The artwork is released into the public domain (see `public-license.txt`): it
may be used, modified and redistributed, commercially or not, without
attribution. The pack's music, which carries its own credit requirement, is
not included here.

Files included, renamed from the pack's `PNG/spritesheets/`:

- `fox-idle.png` (`player-idle.png`), `fox-run.png` (`payer-run.png`)
- `frog-idle.png`, `eagle-fly.png` (`eagle-attack.png`), `opossum.png` (`oposum.png`)
